# QoF v1.5.0's "Well Equipped" Update

> [!NOTE]
> A Minecraft Bedrock addon that adds small vanilla-friendly features. Each module is configurable through the in-game pack settings panel. Requires **BetaAPIs** enabled under Experiments.

## Changelogs

* all major updates are now named
* some frequently used player data is now cached: "name", "platform type", "gamemode", and "permission level"  
* permission level is no longer ignored, players now need at least "member" permission to interact with QoF  
* new command: "/info"  
  * shows the current QoF version
  * shows which modules are enabled
  * useful for bug reports
* removed some settings considered "too advanced"
      
> if you still want to edit removed configs, check "~/behaviors\_pack/QoF/scripts/\_config.js"
> guide: https://github.com/aitji/QoF/blob/behavior\_packs/src/\_config.ts

## License Change

- Changed the software license from MIT License to the QoF Noncommercial License 1.0.

## Bartering Bat

this module is managed by [@pickerth\_12](https://github.com/pickerth_12) and cannot be disabled because it does not live in scripts

* hold a "glow berry" to lure a bat
* feed a bat with a "glow berry" to trade
* 2 minute cooldown per trade

## Offhand

* micro optimization to item checking logic
